authorization: Original study execution request, repeated instructions to continue all reruns and defer manuscript decisions, and the current heartbeat mandate.
approved_scope: Remaining 28 original-setting extensions followed by four preplanned resolution checks, under the frozen protocol and job manifest.
decision_basis: All eight pilot executions are complete; independent scalar extraction, virtual-stop chronology, original-input identity, configured overrides and source checksums agree.
Six extension pilots demonstrate that integrated response can change with or without a changed maximum. A-to-B reproduction is separated from B-to-C loading.

Numerical flags have been investigated through independent saved-state checks and the separately versioned Q1-Q8 diagnostics. No original-setting pilot trajectory passes every residual check; Q4-Q7-Q8 do not establish strain-increment convergence.

The user-authorized study remains informative as a protocol/numerical-sensitivity audit of the original instrument. These limitations are retained in figures, tables and interpretation, rather than changing the original solver during the primary comparison.
retained_limitations: Driver failure flags are operational stopping outcomes, not certificates of numerical convergence.
Residual exceedances, reproduction differences, remaining censoring and failed diagnostics must stay explicit.
Do not infer a corrected unique failure endpoint or silently replace the original report.
No additional strict-branch loading runs or progressively finer controls are released by this gate.

budget_scenario.assumption: 28 extensions at pilot median cost, four resolution cases at twice their pilot cost, three workers continuously awake. Changing contention, geometry and iteration cost make this a planning scenario, not a deadline.
budget_scenario.storage_assumption: 28 production runs plus four resolution runs at twice the pilot median storage; excludes additional analysis snapshots.
